beads.description: internal/cli/root_test.go already has TestVersionLdflagsMatchMakefile, which reads the Makefile and fails if the -X slop-cannon/internal/cli.{Version,Commit,Date} flags are renamed. .goreleaser.yaml carries the same three -X flags for its release builds but nothing guards them, so renaming one of the three cli package variables would pass the Makefile test's sibling check yet still ship a release binary that silently prints "dev" instead of failing. Add a new test in the same file, internal/cli/root_test.go, that reads ../../.goreleaser.yaml (following the existing test's pattern of os.ReadFile plus require.Contains) and asserts each of slop-cannon/internal/cli.Version, slop-cannon/internal/cli.Commit and slop-cannon/internal/cli.Date appears in its ldflags block. Do not modify .goreleaser.yaml, the Makefile, or IMPLEMENTATION-PROGRESS.md — this bead only adds the test.
beads.acceptance: A new test function exists in internal/cli/root_test.go (distinct from TestVersionLdflagsMatchMakefile) that reads ../../.goreleaser.yaml and asserts the substrings slop-cannon/internal/cli.Version, slop-cannon/internal/cli.Commit and slop-cannon/internal/cli.Date each appear in the file contents. Renaming any one of the three cli package variables referenced by .goreleaser.yaml's ldflags (Version, Commit, or Date) causes this new test to fail. `go test ./internal/cli/...` passes with .goreleaser.yaml unchanged. .goreleaser.yaml, the Makefile, and IMPLEMENTATION-PROGRESS.md are not modified by this change.

beads.title: Add test pinning .goreleaser.yaml's ldflags to internal/cli variable names
beads.description: internal/cli/root_test.go already has TestVersionLdflagsMatchMakefile, which reads the Makefile and fails if the -X slop-cannon/internal/cli.{Version,Commit,Date} flags are renamed. .goreleaser.yaml carries the same three -X flags for its release builds but nothing guards them, so renaming one of the three cli package variables would pass the Makefile test's sibling check yet still ship a release binary that silently prints "dev" instead of failing. Add a new test in the same file, internal/cli/root_test.go, that reads ../../.goreleaser.yaml (following the existing test's pattern of os.ReadFile plus require.Contains) and asserts each of slop-cannon/internal/cli.Version, slop-cannon/internal/cli.Commit and slop-cannon/internal/cli.Date appears in its ldflags block. Do not modify .goreleaser.yaml, the Makefile, or IMPLEMENTATION-PROGRESS.md — this bead only adds the test.
beads.acceptance: A new test function exists in internal/cli/root_test.go (distinct from TestVersionLdflagsMatchMakefile) that reads ../../.goreleaser.yaml and asserts the substrings slop-cannon/internal/cli.Version, slop-cannon/internal/cli.Commit and slop-cannon/internal/cli.Date each appear in the file contents. Renaming any one of the three cli package variables referenced by .goreleaser.yaml's ldflags (Version, Commit, or Date) causes this new test to fail. `go test ./internal/cli/...` passes with .goreleaser.yaml unchanged. .goreleaser.yaml, the Makefile, and IMPLEMENTATION-PROGRESS.md are not modified by this change.
